body.name: Sequential weighted random isolation law
body.construction: Independently draw \(X_{\ell i}\) with density \(h_{\ell i}x^{h_{\ell i}-1}\) on \((0,1)\), scan vertices in decreasing \(X_{\ell i}\), and include a scanned vertex in \(S_{\ell}\) exactly when it has no previously included neighbor in \(C_G\).
